name: Lamp Glow
description: Hold a lamp-like glow of qi over a hurt and let the soft light draw the wound closed.

name: Candle Sense
description: Swing a lantern of faint qi over a patient and see which wounds dim the light.

name: Dew Veil
description: Draw a fine veil of dewy qi round a hurt ally so that dust and spray cannot settle.

name: Petal Mend
description: Lay petal-thin layers of qi over a wound one upon another until the flesh of an ally is whole.

name: Spore Purge
description: Pick the seeded rot of a blight or spore out of the flesh of an ally and burn it clean.

name: Even Draw
description: Draw a worn ally's qi back into an even flow with a slow pull from the healer's hands.

name: Blossoming Recovery
description: Open a flower of healing qi over a wounded ally and let its petals close every cut in turn.

name: Luminous Purification
description: Wash an ally in luminous qi from crown to foot until poison and taint melt out of every part.

name: Dawnlit Remedy
description: Let a rising light of qi pour into the body of an ally and mend the hurt layer by layer.

name: Mending Bloom
description: Open a great bloom of healing qi round the healer so that every ally within it is mended as the petals unfold.

name: Measured Touch
description: Give a hurt exactly the measure of qi it needs and no more through a steady palm.

name: Paired Gauge
description: Compare the pulse at two points on a patient to judge how far the sickness has spread.

name: Even Screen
description: Hold an even screen of qi over a patient so the rite is not broken by blows or noise.

name: Ritual Mending
description: Mend a deep wound through the steps of a fixed rite so each pulse of qi lands in order.

name: Ritual Cleanse
description: Draw taint and poison from an ally through the measured steps of the cleansing rite.

name: Measured Breath
description: Count a patient's breath aloud and match it with qi so the ally's lungs find a full even rhythm.

name: Measured Dose
description: Pass the exact dose of healing qi a failing body can bear in one clean pulse.

name: Solemn Revival
description: Perform the solemn rite of recall over an ally whose heart has just failed and drive the life back.

name: Ordered Restoration
description: Restore each failing organ of an ally in a fixed order so no part is mended at another's cost.

name: Physician's Grace
description: Bestow the full grace of a master physician's two hands upon one patient until the body is set right.

name: Paired Resurgence
description: Join both hands in the closing rite and raise a patient from the depths of wounds with a single paired surge of qi.

name: Streamlet Touch
description: Let a streamlet of qi run from the fingertips into a hurt and carry its ache downstream.

name: Swirl Reading
description: Watch the eddies in a patient's qi to find where the current is stalled by injury.

name: Reed Screen
description: Weave a screen of upright qi strands round a patient that bends before a blow and holds.

name: Joined Flow
description: Join two currents of qi from the hands in a wound so the flesh of an ally knits where they meet.

name: Parting Rinse
description: Part the taint from the clean qi of a patient with two streams that flow in opposite ways.

name: Meeting Currents
description: Let the healer's current meet an ally's and lend it force until both run strong together.

name: Tidal Restoration
description: Raise a tide of healing qi that sweeps up the wounds of an ally and sets them whole as it ebbs.

name: Scouring Tide
description: Flush a poisoned ally with a strong rolling tide of clean qi that carries every toxin out at the skin.

name: Twinflow Remedy
description: Run twin streams of remedy through the body of an ally so that two grievous hurts are mended at once.

name: Confluence Mending
description: Send two rivers of healing qi to meet on the worst wound of an ally and fuse everything beneath the meeting.

name: Plunge Touch
description: Drop the whole weight of the hand onto a swelling to burst and disperse it with healing qi.

name: Keen Pulse
description: Pick out the weakest thread of a patient's pulse as a hawk picks one mark from a field.

name: Brimming Palm
description: Fill the palm with healing qi till it brims and tip it onto the wound of an ally.

name: Cupped Guard
description: Cup both hands over the patient with qi held between them like water in a bowl that no blow can spill.

name: Stooping Mend
description: Drop from height onto a fallen ally with a healing pulse already sent ahead of the landing.

name: Wing Draw
description: Beat out the taint of a body with sweeping strokes of qi as a wing beats away smoke.

name: Swooping Lift
description: Scoop a hurt ally up in one clean motion and lend the lifted body a pulse of repair.

name: Still Calm
description: Settle a panicked ally in a still pool of qi until the breath and thought both steady.

name: Swift Revival
description: Dive at a freshly fallen ally and strike the heart with qi in the moment before life departs.

name: Brimming Recovery
description: Pour a brimming basin of qi down into a broken body and let it overflow into every wound.

name: Plunging Remedy
description: Drive a hawk-swift column of remedy into a patient from above and seal the worst wounds on impact.

name: Descending Mercy
description: Gather all the basin's qi overhead and let it fall like a hawk in a single stroke of mercy upon the wounded.

name: High Touch
description: Raise the hand high and bring it down with a light touch that leaves the wound clean and closed.

name: Height Gauge
description: Gauge how high a patient's strength can climb before the healing must turn to rest.

name: Bright Screen
description: Spread a bright screen of qi over the patient to turn aside fire and spray.

name: Radiant Mend
description: Mend with a hand that shines with the Core's own light and closes the wound as it passes.

name: Gleaming Purge
description: Burn taint and curse from a body with the clean light of a formed Core.

name: Rising Rally
description: Raise a flagging ally's reserves with a surge of Core qi that fills the limbs from below.

name: Exacting Restoration
description: Restore a damaged body to its exact former state with finely measured qi from a formed Core.

name: Perfect Cleansing
description: Lift every grain of taint from the body of an ally until the qi runs perfectly clear.

name: Highest Remedy
description: Apply the highest remedy of the school and pour the Core's depth into a body that no lesser art could mend.

name: Zenith Restoration
description: Raise the healer's Core to its brightest and flood a body with qi that restores it to full health.

name: Fresh Gale
description: Blow a fresh clean gust of healing qi over a hurt so the sting of an ally eases.

name: Air Sense
description: Read the way the air moves round a patient to learn where the body is hurt.

name: Light Draft
description: Hold a light draft round a wounded ally that pushes aside smoke and stray cinders.

name: Wind Knit
description: Knit the edges of a wound together with threads of qi drawn tight by the wind.

name: Gale Scour
description: Scour taint from the skin and breath of an ally with a swift cleansing gale.

name: Oath Breath
description: Speak the healer's oath and breathe it into an ally as qi that steadies the heart.

name: Oathwind Recovery
description: Send a sworn wind of mending through an ally that closes the wounds one after another.

name: Quickened Revival
description: Whip a sudden wind of qi round a stilled heart to restart it before the window passes.

name: Oathwind Remedy
description: Pour a sworn remedy on a steady wind into an ally until the worst injuries have closed.

name: Oathwind Restoration
description: Call down the full sworn wind of the school and restore every wound of the allies within its sweep.

name: Firm Touch
description: Press a firm hand to a wound and hold until the qi has stopped the bleeding of an ally.

name: Vigor Sense
description: Judge by a level touch how much strength the wounded body has to spare for the healing.

name: Warding Palm
description: Hold a sheltering palm over the head of a patient to deflect falling stones.

name: Hearth Mending
description: Warm the wounded as at a hearth with slow steady qi that mends them through the night.

name: Stone Rinse
description: Rinse stubborn taint from a body with a heavy slow flow of qi that nothing foul can resist.

name: Vowed Breath
description: Share a vowed breath with a failing ally so the lungs keep their rhythm through the night.

name: Dutiful Recovery
description: Tend an ally through hours of recovery with a dutiful flow of qi that never fades.

name: Dutiful Purification
description: Purify an ally of poison and curse through a long night of unbroken cleansing qi.

name: Vowed Remedy
description: Give the vowed remedy of the school to an ally and refuse to cease until the body has healed.

name: Vowed Recovery
description: Make the school's vow in qi and mend every ally within reach no matter how long the mending takes.

name: Bearing Touch
description: Take a bearing on the wound by feel and touch it with qi at exactly the right place.

name: Strength Reading
description: Sense which way a patient's strength is heading toward recovery or toward failing.

name: Gust Screen
description: Throw up a gusting screen to beat back dust and splinters from a wounded ally.

name: Fixed Mend
description: Hold a fixed line of qi on a wound until it has closed however the patient shifts.

name: Crosswind Rinse
description: Drive a crosswind of clean qi through a tainted body and out at the skin.

name: Mutual Breath
description: Hold the healer's own breath in time with a failing ally until the rhythm of the two falls together.

name: Kept Course
description: Keep an ally's recovery on a steady course by correcting every drift of the pulse as it comes.

name: Unwavering Recovery
description: Hold the bearing of the mending without wavering through hours of wind and until the ally has healed.

name: Moored Revival
description: Anchor a drifting life to the body with qi cast on a fixed bearing before it is lost.

name: Bearing Remedy
description: Take the fixed bearing of the school and send its remedy straight to the core of the injury.

name: Bearing Revival
description: Hold the bearing of the school and call a lately fallen ally back to the body along a single line of qi.

name: Drawn Touch
description: Draw the hand slowly along a wound and let qi follow the stroke to close the flesh.

name: Quiet Gauge
description: Take a hushed measure of a patient's reserves before the great draw begins.

name: Drawn Guard
description: Draw a guard of qi across the patient in one stroke to turn aside a thrown weapon.

name: Wide Mending
description: Mend a broad area of damage in one sweeping draw so many small wounds close together.

name: Draw Cleanse
description: Draw the whole taint of a poisoned ally into one stream and pull it free of the body.

name: Drawn Breath
description: Draw a deep breath with a weary ally and share the fullness of it as qi.

name: Great Restoration
description: Draw on the school's great store of qi to restore a badly wounded ally in a single sitting.

name: Deep Revival
description: Draw up qi from the dantian's depth and drive it into an ally who has just stopped breathing.

name: Mighty Mercy
description: Give a mighty draught of mercy as qi to an ally so deep and strong that old injuries are lifted too.

name: Unfettered Mercy
description: Draw the great draw to its fullest and give mercy without measure to every ally in reach.

name: Unbowed Touch
description: Touch a wound with a hand that does not tremble even when winds are rising round it.

name: Anchor Sense
description: Anchor the senses in the patient's body and feel through all noise for the wound that matters.

name: Calm Screen
description: Hold a calm screen of qi round the patient that wind and blow alike cannot move.

name: Stout Breath
description: Give an ally a stout breath of qi that sets the lungs working against any weight.

name: Oath Knit
description: Knit torn flesh with an oath behind every thread so that the mending will not fail.

name: Wind Purge
description: Purge poison from a body with a clean unrelenting wind of Core qi.

name: Stout Mending
description: Mend heavy wounds with strong qi that does not tire however long the work.

name: Staunch Rally
description: Rally a broken ally with a staunch surge of Core qi that gives back the will to stand.

name: Immovable Recovery
description: Hold the mending firm as stone in the face of every blow until the ally has recovered.

name: Fearless Cleansing
description: Cleanse even a curse of terrible weight from an ally without flinching from its backlash.

name: Unbowed Remedy
description: Pour the unbowed remedy of the oath into an ally until even the oldest hurt gives way.

name: Unbowed Renewal
description: Stand unbowed against the wind and make an ally new from the bones outward.
